name: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk
role: Founder and first president of the Republic of Turkey (1923–1938)
summary: Atatürk pursued national independence, republican sovereignty, secular law and rapid cultural modernisation. His later economic program used state enterprises and industrial planning alongside private enterprise; his one-party government also imposed assimilation and violently suppressed resistance.
